title: Review large inline list
why: This pattern often indicates unfinished, redundant, or error-prone code.
suggestion: Clarify the intent or replace the suspicious construct.
limitations: Generated files, Rust test regions, C/C++ collection-like brackets, CSS declaration blocks, Objective-C braced initializer data, and Java static final array data are excluded. C++ square brackets denote captures or subscripts rather than collection literals; Objective-C square-bracket literals remain eligible.
